title: An artificial intelligence-based audio recognition system for dysarthria home-based rehabilitation: A proof-of-concept study.
summary: Whisper-ST1 fine-tuned from Whisper-base classifies dysarthria severity from real-world and research speech; held-out metrics and therapist agreement support a bounded proof-of-concept result.
ai_technology: transfer learning, progressive unfreezing and ordinal regression on TORGO plus social-media speech; held-out sample accuracy 75%, macro-F1 72%, and therapist agreement. Authors explicitly state external robustness and clinical effectiveness remain unestablished.
